units: <cite ref="Mishnah Sanhedrin 9:1">Snh. IX, 1</cite>, v. <cite ref="N01325"><he>נָשַׁךְ</he></cite>; <cite ref="Bava Kamma 23b:6">B. Kam. 23ᵇ</cite>.

<cite ref="Bava Kamma 23b:6">Ib.</cite> <he>מאן פטור מְשַׁסֶּה וכ׳</he> who is exempt from responsibility? Is he exempt that set the dog on, and is the owner of the dog responsible? <cite ref="Bava Kamma 24b:6">Ib. 24ᵇ</cite> <he>המשסה … חבירו בחבירו</he> he who sets his neighbor’s dog on a neighbor; <he>שִׁיסָּהוּ הוא בעצמו</he> if he incited the neighbor’s dog against himself.
Gen. R. s. 84 באו ונְשַׁסֶּה בו וכ׳ come, let us set on the dogs against him (Joseph); a. e.—[Bibl. Hebr. שסה to plunder, cmp. שָׁסַע.]
